whenToUse: Team member lists in messengers or collaboration tools.
You show whether someone can answer right away.
People let others know their own status.
whenNotToUse: Services where privacy matters (let people choose to share their status).
The state of services or devices (use a status dot).
It can't be updated in real time.

alternatives.name: Status Dot
alternatives.reason: The state of something other than a person.

alternatives.name: Avatar
alternatives.reason: Showing just the person, without status.

accessibility: The status is included in the avatar's name, read as "Kim Haneul, away".
Away is a half circle and offline an empty circle, so the shape differs, not color alone.
Lists also show the status in words.
Your own status changes with a native select.
